purpose: Record applicability and evidence-backed verdicts for OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 chapter V3 (Web Frontend Security) — 31 requirements — in the machine-readable decision register, with no code changes.
requiredInvariants: Every V3 requirement is either an explicit decision (APPLICABLE with PASS/FAIL, or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION with a real self-revoking condition) or is deliberately left undeclared to fall through to the honest PENDING_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW/NOT_ASSESSED default.
Every applicability=NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION decision has status=NOT_APPLICABLE and vice versa, verified across the whole decisions file before every push.

A PASS or FAIL is only recorded where the underlying code (middleware.ts security headers, server-request-security.ts CSRF, cookie option objects, main.ts CORS, storage.service.ts download URLs, tsconfig.base.json) was read and the cited pattern verified against the live tree in this pass.

The served CSP is read from apps/web/middleware.ts, which the repository's own next.config.js comment identifies as taking precedence over the different, vestigial policy still listed there — the assessment does not cite the superseded next.config.js policy as the effective one.

Findings that name real gaps (missing CSP object-src/base-uri hardening, missing COOP/CSP-report-uri headers, cookie name prefix absence, disabled TypeScript strict mode, unforced Content-Disposition on downloads) are recorded as evidence for future remediation, not fixed here.
No security control is weakened; Semgrep, the pinning ratchet and every other gate stay at full strength.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
This scope changes no application code.
acceptance: docs/security/asvs-applicability-decisions.json gains exactly 25 new V3.* decisions and no duplicates; the remaining 6 V3 requirements stay undeclared (PENDING_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW/NOT_ASSESSED).
The evidence gate rejects 0 decisions; decisionsApplied increases by 25; finalPass stays false.
scripts/security/*.test.mjs stays 60/60 (JSON-only change, no script logic touched).
A file-wide applicability/status consistency check reports 0 inconsistencies before every push.
Every FAIL and PASS note cites a real file and pattern checked against the live tree in this pass.
